verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents a SQL API, a REST API for running queries and managing the deployment, plus a Snowflake-managed MCP server that lets AI agents securely retrieve data, including SQL executions as tools. Governance comes from role-based access control, where privileges are assigned to roles. Together these cover the core of a dashboard-free agent querying loop. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the authentication flow for programmatic or agent identities, explicit schema-discovery endpoints or tools, evidence that the Snowflake CLI itself executes SQL (its cited docs cover only app management), details on result retrieval or formats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
